summary: Frontend-only testing for AMZ Prints ERP mock-mode invoice/customer/production upgrades. Login, /invoices compact cards + Create Invoice, /invoices/new form (customer select autofill, add-new-customer inline dialog, live grand total incl. previous balance, derived status Partial), Save→View→Edit round-trip, /customers portal with ledger dialog (Total Billed/Paid/Outstanding + Invoices/Orders/Payments tabs), /production kanban with 7 stages and stage-advance button, and regression navigation all verified. Found & fixed one blocker in mockOrdersAPI (non-stateful getAll causing kanban moves to silently revert).

integration_issues.flow: Production kanban → Move to next stage
integration_issues.issue: BEFORE FIX: mockOrdersAPI.getAll() returned a fresh literal array every call and mockOrdersAPI.update()/create()/delete() were no-ops. Clicking the 'Next stage' button showed a success toast but the card snapped back on the next fetch. Fixed by making mockOrders module-scoped stateful (getAll/getById/create/update/delete/duplicate now mutate the same array).

issues: React warning: Select is changing from uncontrolled to controlled — InvoiceForm's Select uses value={formData.customerId || undefined}; passing '' vs undefined toggles controlled/uncontrolled. Suggest initialising customerId to undefined or always passing a defined string.
Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby / Description — a11y warning on new-customer-dialog, customer-dialog and ledger-dialog. Add <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby to silence.

action_items: (Optional) Silence 'controlled/uncontrolled Select' warning by using undefined initial customerId (or a fixed placeholder value).
(Optional) Add DialogDescription to the three Dialog components for a11y.
Consider persisting mock state to localStorage so refresh doesn't wipe kanban moves & newly-added customers/invoices (currently in-memory only).
critical_code_review_comments: mockOrdersAPI previously returned a NEW literal from getAll() on every call while update()/create()/delete() were pure no-ops. Any UI feature that depends on optimistic-refetch (Production kanban, Order edits) would silently revert. FIXED in mockAuth.js.
InvoiceForm.jsx: Select's value passes `formData.customerId || undefined`, which flips between undefined and '' — triggers React controlled/uncontrolled warning. Not functional but noisy.

InvoiceForm.jsx handleSave computes derivedStatus based on `balance` (which already includes previousBalance). This is correct — Grand Total = subtotal+tax−discount+prevBal, and status marks Paid only when the fully-inclusive balance ≤ 0. Verified visually.

mockCustomersAPI.getLedger references mockOrdersFull (empty array) — order history in ledger will always be empty until real orders API pushes into that array or ledger reads mockOrders. Consider unifying to mockOrders.
Invoices card grid `xl:grid-cols-4` present ✔; cards expose data-testids for view/edit/share/whatsapp ✔.
seed_data_creation: Uses existing seeded ABC Corporation, XYZ Enterprises, INV-2024-001, INV-2024-002, ORD-001, ORD-002.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 13 explicit acceptance items pass. Only one blocker was found & fixed (mockOrdersAPI now stateful). Remaining items are non-blocking React/a11y console warnings. Ledger 'Orders' tab will always show 0 until the mock order list is wired into mockCustomersAPI.getLedger (currently reads mockOrdersFull which is never populated).
rca of the issue: Production kanban Next-stage click → ordersAPI.update() → mock update was a no-op (returned {id,...data} but did not mutate any store). Fresh getAll() then returned the original seed, so the moved order appeared to snap back. Root cause: mockOrdersAPI was written as a stateless stub while other mock modules (customers, invoices, products) are stateful. Fix: refactored mockOrdersAPI to use a module-scoped `mockOrders` array with proper CRUD mutations, matching the pattern used by mockCustomersAPI and mockInvoicesAPI.
